verdict.rationale: Cookieless tracking is a fair question for a product analytics tool like Heap, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions cookies, a cookieless mode, or reducing consent-banner requirements. The server-side track APIs and PII redaction controls are adjacent building blocks or different privacy features, not a documented cookieless capability.

support.subject: As a founder, I can track product usage without third-party cookies so I can minimize or avoid cookie consent banners
